firewall.physical_property: candidate and independent checker must not import detector/WL/E3 modules and must operate only on the sealed bundle plus their own standard-library code

interface_language.name: OR_OF_CANONICAL_RESIDUAL_CSP_BRANCHES
interface_language.required_symmetry_identity: Residual(0,1) == Residual(1,0) under canonical exact CSP restriction
interface_language.representation: I = OR over representatives a in {(0,0),(0,1),(1,1)} of conjunctions of canonical residual CSP constraints on boundary variables

construction.local_region_definition: all reduced CSP constraints whose scope intersects {40,240}
construction.exterior_definition: all reduced CSP constraints whose scope is disjoint from {40,240}
construction.boundary_definition: all variables other than 40,240 that appear in the local region
construction.residual_rule: for each internal assignment, restrict every local allowed-tuple relation by the assigned internal bits; project surviving tuples to remaining boundary scope; canonicalize duplicate residual relations
construction.unsat_branch_rule: if any restricted local constraint has no surviving tuple, the branch is UNSAT and represented canonically
construction.symmetry_compression_rule: drop raw branch (1,0) only if an independent canonical residual comparison proves it identical to branch (0,1)

exactness_obligation.local_equivalence: For every boundary assignment beta, I(beta)=1 iff exists x40,x240 such that all local-region constraints are satisfied.
exactness_obligation.global_single_cell_factorization: The reduced formula is equivalent to Exterior AND I because only the internal cell is existentially eliminated and all other constraints remain unchanged.
exactness_obligation.proof_method: structural Shannon-style elimination over exactly two frozen internal variables plus exact residual equality of the swapped mixed branches; no enumeration of boundary assignments

polynomial_accounting.input_measure: size of sealed reduced CSP bundle in symbols/tuples
polynomial_accounting.build_bound_claim_to_test: O(|F_local|) with constant three retained orbit branches after one four-branch residual construction/check
polynomial_accounting.interface_size_claim_to_test: O(|F_local|) for this fixed two-variable frozen cell
polynomial_accounting.verification_bound_claim_to_test: O(|F_local| log |F_local|) or better for canonicalization/comparison
polynomial_accounting.reconstruction_bound_claim_to_test: O(|F_local|) to select a satisfying retained branch for a supplied satisfying boundary assignment

pass_conditions: sealed reduced hash matches frozen UF250_020 reduced_raw_sha256
mixed residual branches 01 and 10 are canonically identical
candidate builds the exact preregistered interface with only 00,01,11 retained
independent checker independently rebuilds all four raw residual branches from the sealed bundle
independent checker proves 01 == 10 and candidate interface matches the canonical retained branches exactly
no SAT solver, no boundary cube enumeration, no detector/WL/E3 imports
measured interface size and all construction/verification operations obey the scoped polynomial accounting

outcome_rules.FAIL_CLOSURE_BLOWUP: exact local relation is obtained only by violating the preregistered polynomial-size/construction constraints
outcome_rules.FAIL_NONLOCAL_INFORMATION_REQUIRED: the sealed local bundle plus frozen witness is insufficient to establish the required exact interface without forbidden nonlocal information
outcome_rules.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: execution cannot finish within frozen resource limits without establishing a semantic failure

next_if_pass: Proceed to a separately preregistered MANTEQUILLA_DETECTION_TO_POLYNOMIAL_EXACT_CLOSURE_CERTIFICATE_GATE and then composition tests; do not count UF250_020 as independent confirmation of the Mantequilla hypothesis.
next_if_fail: Characterize whether failure is representation complexity or missing nonlocal information before changing the interface language.
